WITH grouped_data AS (
  SELECT 
    sp.zoneref,
    s.insurstat,
    AVG(sp.remaingb) as avg_remaining_storage,
    AVG(sp.proccpu - sp.procgpu) as avg_cpu_gpu_gap
  FROM scanprocessing sp
  INNER JOIN sites s ON sp.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY sp.zoneref, s.insurstat
),
mean_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_remaining_storage) as mean_remaining_storage
  FROM grouped_data
)
SELECT 
  gd.zoneref,
  gd.insurstat,
  gd.avg_remaining_storage,
  gd.avg_cpu_gpu_gap,
  gd.avg_remaining_storage / mc.mean_remaining_storage as storage_ratio
FROM grouped_data gd
CROSS JOIN mean_calc mc
WHERE mc.mean_remaining_storage IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY storage_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10
